scope: Artificial neutral-rest target in model coordinates, not an avatar aesthetic score.

inputs.unit: runtime parameter values, not measured physical angles

metric: Maximum vertex distance from specified target over face, eyes, eyebrows and mouth.
limitations: Prototype not integrated into the production runtime.
Coordinates do not measure likeness, occlusion or natural motion.
No new real-device VTS or OBS verification.
Production 43-test and executable records are historical, not rerun for this study.
publicScope: Aggregate coordinates only; no character artwork, meshes, private paths, tracking logs or credentials.
